corrected_prompt:
Photoreal POV photo, vertical 9:16, 35mm lens, shallow depth of field. Look: a POV dramatization with hands only and never a face; a warm evening home office lit by a tungsten desk lamp from the left, soft shadows, natural skin; the owner's wrist always in a mustard-yellow knit sweater sleeve; muted warm palette of walnut, warm grey and mustard, the phone screen the brightest thing in the frame.
Reference images: none attached; this prompt is the only input.
Subject: one modern black smartphone with one screen on its front, held upright by the viewer and tilted slightly back toward the camera, centred (x 18% to 82% of the frame width) in the lower two thirds (y 34% to 96%), close to the camera; it appears once.
Hands: one adult hand seen from the viewer's own point of view, wrist in a mustard-yellow knit sleeve. The left hand holds the phone from below, four fingers around the lower back edge and the thumb on the left side. The other hand is out of frame. The hand is in front of the phone's lower edge, well below the message bubble. No finger covers any letter of the message, and no letter touches the hand or sleeve. Exactly one hand with five fingers.
Action: the left hand's fingers grip the phone's lower back edge, the thumb rests on the left side edge; the phone is still.
Props: the phone is a plain black smartphone with thin bezels and rounded corners, no logo on the case or the glass. Its screen is lit and shows a plain chat view on a white background with exactly one large light-grey incoming message bubble near the top of the screen, aligned to the left, and empty white space below it; no names, no avatars, no status bar, no time, no app logo.
Text: inside the one grey bubble, the only text on the phone screen, in dark charcoal plain sans-serif, set large on 2 or 3 lines so it reads at phone size: "We found someone cheaper." Sentence case, exactly these words and punctuation. Every line ends well before the bubble's edge. Nothing touches a letter.
Setting: a home office in the evening seen over the hand: the warm walnut desk surface visible behind and beside the phone and in the bottom strip, soft and out of focus, a blurred mug at the right edge, the wall behind dark warm grey, plain and out of focus. No other screens, posters or readable words anywhere.
Camera: first person looking down at the phone at about 30 degrees, phone screen sharp, 9:16. The top 32% of the frame is a calm, dark, out-of-focus wall with nothing in it. The right 13% holds nothing important. The bottom 10% holds only the hand and the desk.
Continuity: none, this is the first frame of the reel.
Negatives: no face and no reflection of a face in the screen; no logo, brand or app name; no numbers, no clock, no status bar; no words other than the message; no text on the wall, the mug or the desk; nothing in the top 32% except the calm wall; no second hand.
